body.message:
Please note that, as the security deposit was paid in cash, we can process the refund either in cash or via bank transfer.

If you prefer a bank transfer, kindly share your bank account details with us. Please note that the bank transfer refund may take up to 7 working days to be processed.

In the meantime, may I kindly know your expected check-out time so that we can make the necessary arrangements accordingly?
